The complete bibliography of the team — **577 references**, every journal and
every author position.

For the shorter, curated view — journals with an impact factor above 10, with a
team member in a signing author position — see the main
[publications page](publications.qmd).

[Back to selected publications](publications.qmd){.btn-app}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Sources

**2019–2024** comes from the team's HCERES bibliographic record, deduplicated
across the 19 per-member sheets. Author lists are as recorded there, and each
entry links to a PubMed search on its title.

**2025–2026** comes from a PubMed search across team members with a Lyon
affiliation; those entries carry a direct PubMed link and a DOI.

The HCERES record was compiled from Web of Science and contains a handful of
namesake artefacts — a few references belong to other researchers who share a
surname and initial with a team member. They are left in rather than removed by
guesswork.
:::
